extracted.name: Baked Old Bay® Salmon
extracted.description: Salmon is baked to tender and flaky perfection under a coating of mayonnaise and a sprinkling of Old Bay® seasoning.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Place salmon on the prepared baking sheet. Spread with mayonnaise and sprinkle with Old Bay® seasoning.
Bake in preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 20 minutes.
